markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class prediction set [F1], full model and neighbor agreement, and 0% invasive risk support routine sign-out.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 99%, InSitu 1%, Normal 0%, Invasive 0% | Strong benign score, zero invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Benign} (alpha 10%, 90% dataset coverage) | Single class at 90% dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 98th OOD percentile (12/12 regions) [F6] | Input passes quality checks, unflagged |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Benign (83%–89% similarity) [F5] | All nearest reference cases match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.28, contribution -0.77) pushes strongly against invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.33, contribution -0.33) against invasion [F3]; 0/20 spot-checked · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 1, 3, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (1.13, contribution -0.31) favors non-invasive architecture [F4] · Weak
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 2, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical text score (1.16, contribution -0.29) supports benign tubules · Weak
- **Nuclear size and variation** (regions 0, 3, 4) · context · Small mean 35.8 µm² (0th percentile) [F7], high variation (100th) [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Duct-confined atypia (regions 1, 3, 9) and 100th-percentile nuclear size variation represent in situ carcinoma (1% probability).
- Focal changes in region 0 (9% risk) or region 4 (2% risk) harbor invasion missed by slide-level pooling.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 4**: Inspect highest-risk areas (9% and 2% risk) to rule out focal stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 1, 3, 9**: Check duct-confined epithelium and region 3 nuclear variation (32 neoplastic nuclei, 0% immune cells [F9]).
3. **Regions 2, 7, 10**: Verify benign tubules and lobules directly; ignore unreliable mitoses and lobule concept scores.
